channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula assina medida provisória para zerar "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a provisional measure to eliminate federal taxation on imported goods valued at up to US$ 50, commonly referred to as the 'blusinhas tax'. The policy aims to lower the cost of goods purchased from international e-commerce platforms and responds to public demand for tax exemptions on low-value imports.

item.title: PL quer definir palanque de Flavio em Minas em até 15 dias
item.description: The PL aims to finalize Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign slate in Minas Gerais within 15 days, with an event scheduled for June 1. Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) is expected to lead the party’s ticket in the state. PL president Valdemar Costa Neto met earlier today with Cleitinho and Flávio to align campaign details.

item.title: Lula assina MP para zerar a ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 20% federal tax on international purchases under $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The change, announced by Chief of Staff Minister Miriam Belchior, takes effect immediately. The move responds to the tax's unpopularity, which was identified as the government's main mistake in an AtlasIntel poll.

item.title: Relator conversa com Moraes e espera dosimetria no STF ainda em maio. Veja vídeo
item.description: Paulinho da Força, the rapporteur of the Dosimetria bill, met with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to discuss the suspension of the law promulgated by Davi Alcolumbre. He described the meeting as positive and expects the STF to rule on the dosimetria issue in the last week of May, once the institutions respond to the minister’s requests.

item.title: Temer compara economia atual a 2016 e cita inflação e juros altos
item.description: Former President Michel Temer compared Brazil's current economy to the situation in 2016, citing high inflation and interest rates, while urging optimism and institutional reforms. He proposed a 'republican pact' among the three branches of government and civil society to drive national development, advocating for election campaigns based on detailed written projects of 20–30 pages. Temer spoke at the Lide Brazil Investment Forum in New York, discussing presidential succession with candidates including Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury.

item.title: ‘Espero neutralidade, nada além disso’, diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre TSE sob comando de Nunes Marques
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, attended the swearing-in of Kassio Nunes Marques as president of the TSE and called for electoral neutrality in 2026, criticizing Alexandre de Moraes’ leadership for 'unbalancing' the 2022 race. He said he would have no issue greeting Lula if they crossed paths and stated that the primary goal is to overturn Jair Bolsonaro’s criminal conviction in the STF, which he called a farce, before addressing his ineligibility.

item.title: Flávio diz esperar 'neutralidade' do TSE em posse de Nunes Marques como presidente da Corte
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he expects 'neutrality' from the TSE during the 2026 elections under the presidency of Minister Nunes Marques. He criticized the tribunal's conduct in 2022, when led by Alexandre de Moraes, calling it 'lamentable' and alleging that the then-president unbalanced the electoral race.

item.title: O que é a 'taxa das blusinhas', que Lula cancelou após quase dois anos?
item.description: President Lula has canceled the 'little shirts tax', a 20% import duty on international shipments under US$ 50, which had been in effect since August 2024. The measure, announced on Tuesday (12) and effective Wednesday, removes the import tax on such purchases, reversing a policy that generated record revenue of R$ 1.78 billion in the first four months of 2026. The change was enacted via a Provisional Measure to be published in the Official Gazette, following internal and external pressure, despite initial support from domestic industry.

item.title: Lula assina MP e zera imposto federal sobre a "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a Provisional Measure eliminating the federal tax on international purchases under US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', effective immediately. The move aims to reduce tax burden on popular consumption, responding to criticism that the tax disproportionately affected low-income groups. While the industrial sector supports the tax for protecting jobs and domestic production, polls show 62% of Brazilians view it as a mistake, increasing pressure on the government to reverse the policy.

item.title: “Medida eleitoreira”, diz líder da oposição ao comentar pressa do governo para redução da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition leader in the Chamber of Deputies, Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), accused the Lula government of adopting an 'electoral measure' by pushing for the immediate reduction of the 6×1 work scale after possible congressional approval. He reacted to statements by Labor Minister Luiz Marinho, claiming the government's haste is aimed at electoral gain, not a structured labor reform.

item.title: Lula diz que criará Ministério da Segurança se PEC for aprovada
item.description: President Lula announced he will create the Ministry of Public Security if the PEC on the topic is approved by the Senate. The proposal, pending in the Senate since March, aims to secure permanent funding for the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program, including BNDES financing and allocations from betting revenues and pre-salt surplus. The program, launched with R$11.1 billion, depends on the PEC to ensure budgetary continuity.

item.title: Lula anuncia fim da taxa das blusinhas; compras internacionais de até US$ 50 não pagarão imposto
item.description: The Lula government announced the end of the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', to be formalized via a Provisional Measure and take effect after publication in the Official Gazette. The move, made less than five months before the 2026 elections, represents a fiscal renunciation, as the government had collected R$ 1.78 billion from this tax in the first four months of 2026.

item.title: Oposição pede impeachment contra Moraes por suspensão da lei da redução de penas
item.description: Opposition leader Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB) filed an impeachment request against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for suspending the sentencing reduction law that lowers penalties for those convicted of coup-related acts, such as in the case of Débora do batom. The request was made on Tuesday, May 12, 2026.

item.title: A cinco meses das eleições, Lula anuncia fim da 'taxa das blusinhas', cobrança de 20% sobre compras internacionais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced the end of the 'blusinhas tax', a 20% import duty on international purchases up to US$ 50, through a provisional measure and a Ministry of Finance ordinance. The change, effective Wednesday, keeps ICMS in place but removes the import tax on low-value consumer goods, aiming to ease the burden on lower-income populations. Revenue from the tax reached R$ 1.78 billion in the first four months of 2026, up 25% year-on-year.

item.title: Universidade “não pode ser espaço de baderna”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas praised the police operation that removed students from the USP rectorate, stating that 'the police acted as they should have'. He emphasized that while universities are open spaces for debate and knowledge, they cannot become sites of disorder, underscoring the need for order in academic environments.

item.title: Projeto destina recursos para a compra de imóveis por órgãos do Judiciário
item.description: The National Congress is analyzing a bill that allocates R$4.2 million from the 2026 budget for the acquisition of properties by the Electoral Regional Court of Alagoas and the Regional Labor Court of Paraná. The TRE/AL aims to purchase a property near its current headquarters to reduce costs from dispersed leases, while the TRT/PR seeks to expand its facilities. The project will be reviewed by the Joint Budget Committee before moving to the Congressional plenary.

item.title: Relator da lei da dosimetria posta foto com Moraes após reunião e diz estar 'otimista' sobre validade do texto
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes met with Deputy Paulinho da Força, rapporteur of the Dosimetry Law, which reduces penalties for those involved in coup acts and benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro. After the meeting, Paulinho expressed optimism about the law’s validity and said Moraes indicated the STF judgment could happen in the last week of May. Moraes had previously issued a preliminary injunction suspending the law’s effects, drawing criticism from Bolsonarist figures like Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who alleged improper proximity between the minister and the rapporteur.

item.title: Lula e Trump, PL da Dosimetria: o que movimentou as redes na última semana
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump was the most discussed topic on social media last week, with 44% of posts coming from the far-right, which accused the Brazilian president of giving away national resources like rare earths and avoiding labeling criminal factions as terrorists. In contrast, left-leaning profiles highlighted Lula’s red-carpet reception at the White House and the focus on trade issues, such as export tariffs. Another major topic was the suspension by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the dosimetry law, sparking debate over authoritarianism, mainly among right-wing sectors.

item.title: Nunes Marques promove jantar por adesão com ingressos a R$ 800
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques will assume the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on November 12 and host a fundraising dinner with tickets priced at R$ 800. The event will take place at a venue in Asa Sul, Brasília, starting at 8:30 PM, and is by invitation only.

item.title: Senado aprova a renovação automática da CNH para bons motoristas
item.description: The Senate approved a provisional measure allowing automatic renewal of the National Driver's License (CNH) for drivers with no point-worthy traffic violations in the last 12 months, registered in the National Positive Driver Registry (RNPC). The proposal maintains physical, mental, and psychological aptitude exams but sets a single fixed price, updated annually by the IPCA. The text now awaits sanction by President Lula (PT).

item.title: Ao vivo: Nunes Marques toma posse como presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the TSE at 7 p.m. on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, in Brasília, assuming leadership of Brazil’s Electoral Justice ahead of the 2026 general elections. He had previously served as rapporteur for the electoral rules governing the 2026 vote, emphasizing stronger oversight of voting machines. The ceremony was attended by STF and TSE ministers and executive officials, with protocolary invitations extended to President Lula and former President Bolsonaro — the latter requiring authorization from Justice Alexandre de Moraes to attend.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que obras de Sabesp 'tiram o sono' após explosão em Jaguaré
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the explosion in Jaguaré requires a review of safety protocols and that Sabesp's works have become a source of concern, keeping authorities awake at night.

item.title: Oposição minimiza possibilidade de ‘tretas’ internas prejudicarem Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro downplay the impact of internal right-wing conflicts, arguing that such disputes do not directly harm him and may even strengthen his image as a plural candidate capable of attracting voters beyond his father’s radical base. They believe the absence of direct attacks on Flávio indicates no faction on the right seeks to undermine him, and his strategic silence allows him to benefit from broad support without engaging in the controversies.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Trump disse “I love you” a Lula pelo telefone de Joesley
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump reportedly told Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva 'I love you' during a phone call made from Joesley Batista’s cellphone, on the eve of May Day, at the Palácio da Alvorada. The call occurred after Lula mentioned difficulties scheduling an in-person meeting with Trump. The report was published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Aprovada pelo Senado MP da renovação automática da CNH para bons condutores
item.description: The Senate approved the MP allowing automatic renewal of the National Driver's License (CNH) for good drivers registered in the RNPC — that is, drivers with no point-based traffic violations in the last 12 months. The proposal also permits physical or digital CNH issuance at the driver’s discretion, retains physical, mental, and psychological exams, but sets a single, annually adjusted fee based on the IPCA. Having been amended by the Legislature, the measure is now a conversion bill (PLV 3/2026) awaiting presidential sanction, following adjustments by rapporteur Renan Filho (MDB-AL).

item.title: Eduardo Leite diz que RS quer virar referência mundial em reconstrução climática
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite of Rio Grande do Sul stated that the state aims to become a global reference in climate reconstruction following historic floods, emphasizing the creation of a permanent governance council with civil society participation and investments in climate monitoring, resilient infrastructure, and fiscal reform. He noted that financial adjustment transformed RS from a state unable to pay its debts into one of Brazil’s top investors in infrastructure and technology, positioning it as a 'game-changing case' in climate resilience.

item.title: ‘Evidente animosidade’: Deltan pede a suspeição de Dino em ação sobre censura a reportagem
item.description: The Novo Party filed a request with the STF seeking the recusal of Minister Flávio Dino in a case concerning the removal of a report about Deltan Dallagnol, citing 'evident animosity' due to Dino's prior request for an investigation into Dallagnol during his tenure as Justice Minister in the Fake News inquiry. The party argues that Dino’s decision overturning the Paraná Electoral Court’s censorship of a Mareli Martins portal article undermines the constitutional requirement of impartiality and appearance of neutrality in judicial proceedings.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques assume o comando do TSE nesta terça
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday (12) in a ceremony attended by representatives of the three branches of government and former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The swearing-in was led by outgoing President Cármen Lúcia, who stepped down early to accelerate election preparations. Although appointed by Bolsonaro, Kassio and new Vice President André Mendonça are expected to adopt a non-interventionist stance, defend electronic voting, and submit decisions to a collegiate body mostly appointed by Lula and Dilma.

item.title: Partido Novo pede suspeição de Dino em ação sobre Dallagnol
item.description: The Novo Party appealed a decision by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, who overturned an order from the Paraná Electoral Justice to take down a report by journalist Marelli Martins on Deltan Dallagnol’s electoral situation. In the appeal, the party requested reconsideration and alleged possible bias or suspicion on Dino’s part. The case centers on press freedom and electoral politics.

item.title: Quaquá critica polarização política e ‘demagogia fiscal’ da direita e da esquerda
item.description: Washington Quaquá, national vice-president of the Workers' Party and mayor of Maricá, criticized Brazil's political polarization, stating that congressional debates often serve only to 'fish for votes' and generate social media content, turning politics into a space of 'virtue signaling' that fails to address real problems. He praised the Centrão as an institutional balancing force that helped contain authoritarian risks during Bolsonaro's government and called for greater moderation, negotiation, and a pragmatic debate on fiscal responsibility — including fighting fraud in social programs regardless of which party is in power.

item.title: Nunes Marques toma posse como presidente do TSE nesta terça-feira
item.description: Nunes Marques assumes the presidency of the TSE this Tuesday, replacing Minister Cármen Lúcia, with André Mendonça as vice-president. The ceremony will include a dinner with tickets priced at R$ 800 and will feature invited former presidents, such as Bolsonaro and Collor, who are currently incarcerated. The TSE, composed of seven ministers, will oversee the October elections for president, governors, senators, and deputies.

item.title: Marcello Lopes vai assumir comunicação de Flávio a partir de junho
item.description: Marcelo Lopes, known as Marcelão, has been officially appointed as communications coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential pre-campaign, set to assume the role in June following a transition period. Although he did not participate in Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 and 2022 campaigns, he had already been informally shaping the communication strategy, including social media and positioning. The team plans to bring in high-profile professionals such as Toninho Neto, Walter Longo, and Alexandre Oltramari, while Marcos Carvalho (Marquinhos) leads the digital front.

item.title: Valdemar ainda quer Ciro Nogueira com Flávio
item.description: The national president of the PL, Valdemar Costa Neto, stated that the party still wants Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) on the ticket with presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, despite the recent Federal Police operation against the senator. The statement was made on Tuesday, the 12th, indicating that the PL maintains its support for the alliance even after the PF carried out searches and seizures as part of Operation Compliance Zero. Ciro Nogueira was targeted in the fifth phase of the operation, which investigates alleged corruption schemes.

item.title: Lula entra no modo campanha e resgata bandeiras de 2025 para tentar pautar eleição
item.description: President Lula has intensified his electoral agenda with an R$ 11 billion plan against organized crime, a speech directly criticizing former President Jair Bolsonaro on the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims, and a visit to the U.S. to meet Donald Trump, aiming to reverse negative perceptions after his STF nominee’s defeat and center the campaign on security, sovereignty, and contrasts with the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Comissão promove nesta quarta-feira dois debates sobre redução da jornada de trabalho
item.description: The Special Committee of the Chamber of Deputees on the End of the 6x1 Scale is holding two public hearings this Wednesday (13) to discuss reducing the workday. At 10 a.m., the focus is on impacts on women and small businesses; at 2 p.m., the debate covers social aspects and the role of social dialogue, with confirmed participation from Minister Guilherme Boulos. The proposal under discussion is PEC 221/19, which seeks to reduce the workday without proportional salary cuts.

item.title: Publicação da CBS e IBS aceleram adaptação fiscal
item.description: The publication of CBS and IBS regulations advances Brazil's tax reform, requiring companies to adapt their fiscal systems by August 2026 to avoid penalties. The transition will be gradual until 2033, necessitating updates to parametrizations, data quality, and staff training to mitigate operational and financial risks.

item.title: Imprensa dos EUA não noticiou que Trump gritou com Lula; imagens são IA
item.description: Social media posts claiming that Donald Trump shouted at Lula during a White House meeting are false and based on AI-generated images. U.S. media did not report any such incident, and there is no credible evidence it occurred. The viral content deceives by presenting deepfakes as factual events.

item.title: Lula presenta un plan para asfixiar las finanzas del crimen organizado y combatir el tráfico de armas
item.description: President Lula unveiled a R$2.25 billion plan to combat organized crime by strangling its finances, regaining prison control, fighting arms trafficking, and improving homicide investigations. The initiative addresses concerns of nearly 70 million Brazilians who witness criminal activity in their neighborhoods, according to a Brazilian Public Safety Forum survey. The package aims to strengthen the government's image on security — a perceived weakness ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Governo Lula expressa ‘surpresa’ e promete reverter veto da UE a exportações de carne
item.description: The Lula government expressed surprise and pledged to reverse the EU's ban on Brazilian meat exports, which were removed from the list of countries complying with antimicrobial use regulations in livestock. The ban, effective September 3, affects live animals and derived products such as beef, poultry, eggs, and honey. Brazil’s ambassador to the EU has a meeting scheduled to seek explanations and ensure compliance with European standards.

item.title: Dino espera recursos no TSE para retomar julgamento das eleições no RJ
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino is awaiting clarification from the TSE on whether former governor Cláudio Castro was cassated or merely declared ineligible before resuming the case on Rio de Janeiro’s elections. The uncertainty keeps interim governor Ricardo Couto in office until the October 2026 general elections, accelerating the electoral race, with Eduardo Paes and Douglas Ruas emerging as leading candidates.

item.title: Julgamento da Lei da Dosimetria pressiona STF e reaviva disputa por narrativa do 8 de janeiro
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until the STF plenary decides on its constitutionality, preventing a single minister from making a unilateral decision and reinforcing collegial legitimacy. The move aims to avoid political confrontation with Congress and counter coup-related narratives, preserving the core of sentences for January 8 acts while allowing minor adjustments.

item.title: Kajuru destaca legitimidade das urnas eletrônicas em ano de eleição
item.description: Senator Jorge Kajuru defended the legitimacy and security of Brazil's electronic voting machines, highlighting their 30-year history and the absence of proven fraud since 1996. He emphasized that the system has enabled the election of representatives across all ideological spectrums, including four Brazilian presidents, and urged the newly appointed TSE President, Minister Nunes Marques, to conduct the electoral process with impartiality, firmness, and balance.

item.title: Amorim evita falar de ligação no telefone de Joesley Batista e diz que encontro com Trump aconteceu em função de Lula
item.description: Celso Amorim downplayed Joesley Batista's role in the Lula-Trump phone call, stating the meeting occurred due to President Lula and declining to comment on alleged intermediaries. Sources say Batista suggested the call while with Lula at the Palácio da Alvorada, and Trump ended the conversation by saying 'I love you'. The in-person meeting took place at the White House on Thursday (7).

item.title: Contarato diz que “ativismo judicial” vem de “omissão do Legislativo”
item.description: Senator Fabiano Contarato (PT-ES) stated that legislative omission in Brazil creates conditions for judicial activism, arguing that when lawmakers fail to legislate, the judiciary steps in to fill the void. His remarks were made at the 15th Lide Brazil Investment Forum in New York, amid rising tensions between branches of government, including over 100 impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices and controversies surrounding the Dosimetry Law and the Banco Master case.

item.title: Temer diz nos EUA que brasileiros têm que “manter o otimismo”
item.description: Former President Michel Temer stated in New York at the LIDE Brazil Investment Forum that Brazilians must 'maintain optimism' despite current economic challenges, comparing the situation to 2016 when he assumed office. He emphasized existing opportunities in Brazil, highlighted the historical Brazil-U.S. relationship, noted the 1891 Brazilian Constitution's inspiration from the U.S. Constitution, and participated in Brazil Week 2026, which gathered pre-candidates, lawmakers, and business leaders.

item.title: Governo diz ter recebido com 'surpresa' veto da UE à carne e promete que agirá 'prontamente para reverter decisão
item.description: The Brazilian government said it was surprised by the European Union's decision to exclude Brazil from the list of countries authorized to export animal meat to the bloc, effective September 3, 2026, and pledged to act swiftly to reverse the measure. Meanwhile, in the U.S., Trump is considering facilitating meat imports and temporarily suspending the gasoline tax, which could benefit Brazilian exporters. Brazil emphasized it is the world's largest animal protein exporter, with UE-bound meat exports reaching US$1.8 billion in 2025.

item.title: Esperidião Amin defende auditagem das urnas e critica suspensão da dosimetria
item.description: Senator Esperidião Amin (PP-SC) advocated for implementing audit mechanisms in electronic voting machines to enhance transparency and trust in Brazil's electoral process, emphasizing that the lack of auditability remains a critical flaw. He also criticized Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF for suspending the Dosimetry Law (Law No. 15.402/2026), arguing that this judicial override undermines the sovereign decision of Congress, which had approved the law after overturning the presidential veto.

item.title: Zema critica STF, defende cortes de gastos e intensifica discurso eleitoral
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema used his participation in the VEJA Brazil Insights New York forum to intensify his pre-electoral discourse, criticizing the Supreme Federal Court (STF) for losing credibility and proposing reforms to its composition, including a minimum age of 60 and greater involvement of the OAB, CNJ, STJ, and PGR. He advocated for public spending cuts, privatizations, a hardline approach to public safety, and classifying criminal factions as terrorist organizations, citing his Minas Gerais administration as a model of fiscal efficiency.

item.title: Mendonça não vê urgência em decidir sobre pedido de instalação da CPI do Master
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça does not consider it urgent to rule on the petition to install the Master CPI, citing his current workload in a related case investigating alleged billion-dollar fraud by former Master Bank CEO Daniel Vorcaro. The petition was filed by right-wing deputies and senators accusing Senate President Davi Alcolumbre of unjustified delay in processing the request. Other justices, including Kassio Nunes Marques and Cristiano Zanin, are also handling similar petitions, with growing concern that the CPI could be exploited as an electoral tool to undermine institutional credibility.

item.title: Datafolha: nova pesquisa mede pela primeira vez a reação dos brasileiros ao Desenrola 2.0
item.description: Datafolha launched a survey from April 12 to 14 with 2,004 respondents to measure the impact of Desenrola 2.0 on Brazilian public opinion, assessing awareness, indebtedness, and perceived benefits. The poll also evaluates the 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio, government approval, and institutional perceptions. Results will be released on April 15 with a maximum margin of error of 2 percentage points.
